data.timing_scope: Serial unpaced file replay. Per-frame time includes decoding, original undistort/crop, encoder input conversion/execution/patch extraction and learned stream processing/cache rebuild/BA. First three frames additionally include saved original dense encoder/patch-array validation and raw NPZ saving. Rejected FP32 gates remain visible and continue only under the explicit diagnostic flag. Native log capture/finite guards are included in encode time; SDK-specific timing remains separate. Model loading/source hashes and report I/O are outside per-frame time but inside driver elapsed; termination is separate offline work. Arrival timestamps are software file-read admission, not physical capture or paced queue latency. No P95 camera/20Hz claim.

timing_contracts.outer: processing=decode_undistort_crop+encoder_outer+stream; replay also includes printing/progress outside per-frame intervals

timing_contracts.Update: Timer includes finite input scan, Torch views, original Update, owned NumPy output copies and finite/domain guard. Weight min/max reporting occurs just after recorded interval.
timing_contracts.corr: correlation_outer includes closing/rebuilding cache, feature concatenation, pool/layout, ID remap, native query and outer finite output scan. cache_preparation and native_query are subsets, never additive to outer.
timing_contracts.stream_remainder: Includes BA, reproject, context gather, state fork and graph copies, flow/removal and guards. BA is not independently timed; remainder is not BA time.
timing_contracts.EOF: 12 offline updates and reconstruction excluded from fresh timing/populations.
